description: Na₃YH₁₂(CO₅)₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.59 Å. Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.49 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) H-O bond length. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one C, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Y and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, one C, and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms.
